## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3 (continued): GitHubPRDefenseStore writes/reads defenses keyed by (pr_number, commit_sha).

## Implementation Notes

Modify `plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh` parallel to T6:

1. Add pr_number parameter and embed in fingerprint computation.
2. Extend defense_record JSON schema to include pr_number field.
3. Reading legacy records (no pr_number field): treat as sentinel=0.
4. List/find: match `record.pr_number == requested OR record.pr_number == 0`.

After implementation: T7's pr-keyed test must pass GREEN. Remove `.test-index` RED marker.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh` | modify | `tests/scripts/test-review-github-defense-store-pr-keyed.sh` (RED in T7) | needs-modification |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (remove marker) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] review-github-defense-store.sh embeds pr_number in fingerprint
  Verify: grep -q 'pr_number' plugins/dso/scripts/review-github-defense-store.sh
- [ ] T7's test now passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-review-github-defense-store-pr-keyed.sh
- [ ] .test-index no longer carries the pr-keyed RED marker for github defense store
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_review_github_defense_store_pr_keyed\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet\xe2\x86\x92opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
